reading.body:
Edpuzzle is an education video tool whose AI feature, question generation, is unverified, and whose pricing is inconsistent across sources.

The data covers one product and one claimed AI capability. Everything about that capability is marked not verified, including the AI question generation itself, the student age range, and the privacy practices. What is documented is the commercial shape: a free plan capped at 20 stored videos, a Pro Teacher tier reported by third parties at $96 to $162 per year, and school plans sold by quote.

That pricing spread matters more than it looks. A range that wide across sources usually means the vendor has changed its tiers, runs regional or promotional pricing, or both, and no third party has kept current. For a school deciding whether to standardize on the tool, the only firm number is the free plan's 20-video ceiling.

Nothing here speaks to compute, buildings, or power. Edpuzzle is a software layer over video hosting and inference, and the data records no infrastructure, no model, and no hosting arrangement. The AI claim cannot be sized from this page, and the page does not claim otherwise.

profile_text.body:
Edpuzzle is an education technology company whose site describes a tool for creating interactive video lessons that can be integrated into a school's learning management system. According to the company, teachers can track student progress through analytics as part of a flipped classroom approach.

The site's material centers on interactive video lessons for teachers and students. The company's tracked product, also named Edpuzzle, is listed under education and research AI, with a note that it was found in research for The AI Ready School and not independently verified. The same note lists AI question generation, also not verified, alongside interactive video lessons as the use case, with teachers and students as the intended users. Student age and privacy practices are not verified. On price, the free plan is limited to 20 stored videos, Pro Teacher is reported by third parties at $96 to $162 per year, and school plans are available by quote, with a caution that the paid price varies across sources.
